messages:
Ava: quick check — kernel prefetch PR landed in draft but we still need the KV interface change merged before we can enable continuous batching on canary. timeline and blockers? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321

Raj: looking. PR is green locally but CI flakes on gpu-e2e. I think it's the driver pin that Eng-Infra promised to bump. will ping them.

Kim: fyi the failing test is `test_kv_cache_eviction::test_eviction_race` — reproduced in CI with this stack: 
```
AssertionError: expected 0 keys but found 3
at tests/kv/test_eviction.py:118
```
I added a non-blocking retry in my branch, but we should root cause.

Noah: @Raj who's the Eng-Infra owner for the driver bump? last note said @maria-infra would do it this sprint.

Raj: @maria-infra or @chip-infra — I'll ping both in infra channel.

Ava: ownership clarification: kernel team (Raj/Kim) owns the PR stability+tests, runtime infra (Noah) to coordinate canary rollout once CI is green, eng-infra to bump drivers. I'll own the cross-team checklist and milestone for this sprint (ETA end of week).

InfraBot: deploy-bot posted: "Driver bump job queued: job/driver-pin-update-2026-03-18 (id: 8842). Status: queued"

Kim: re: tests — I pushed a tiny diagnostic commit that adds timing logs around cache evict. If the infra bump doesn't land today I can try the flaky-retry approach as a stopgap and mark with TODO to backfill a deterministic fix.

Ava: good. Can we get a PR link for the diagnostic commit + the PR that will be merged? drop both here once ready. Also add a note in the PR description listing the canary hosts to target and the rollback gate.

Raj: diagnostic commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/9f3a2b1 — current PR still https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 . I added the canary hosts in the PR body (canary-1/2/3).

Noah: once CI green I'm planning a staged canary: config: `N=3 -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%` with 30m observation windows. I'll trigger the rollout with this command: 
```bash
./ops/deploy_canary --service runtime --policy staged --hosts canary-1,canary-2,canary-3
```
If any latency regressions > 10ms or error spike > 0.5% revert.

Ava: perfect. Next steps: (1) Raj/Kim finish test stability (owner: kernel) (2) Eng-Infra bump drivers (owner: @maria-infra/@chip-infra) (3) Noah prepare canary rollout plan & dashboards (owner: runtime ops) (4) Ava coordinate cross-team and update sprint board. I'll update the ticket and ping again at EOD.

Kim: noted. I'm on it — will post status after I run the longer reproducibility runs (~45m).

Raj: pinged infra in #eng-infra: "driver-pin-update-8842 — can we get eta? blocking kv-prefetch merge for continuous batching canary" :thumbsup:

InfraBot: deploy-bot updated: "job/driver-pin-update-2026-03-18 (id: 8842) started"

Ava: thanks all. If anything slips, we fallback to keeping continuous batching off for canary and still merge kernel perf fixes behind a feature flag. ping me if blockers appear. :rocket:
